description: Opens any markdown table in a thread full width, the way bb already expands images and Mermaid diagrams. Click the table or its corner expand button to see it in a dialog at the window width, with cells wrapping and both axes scrolling when it is still too big. Links, buttons and text selections inside the table keep working; Esc, the close button or the backdrop closes it. Relies on bb's table markup, so a bb update can break it until the plugin catches up.
